## Summary

What changed and why.

## Related issue

Name it with a closing keyword, for example `Closes #12`.

## Test plan

What you ran and what it reported. `bun run build` must precede `bun run test:dist` and
`bun run test:browser`.

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run lint` passes (CI does not check formatting)
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by a test
- [ ] Documentation updated, if this changes deployment, configuration or the cs-control wire contract
